kint is a drop-in MCP server for coding agents that keeps Sibyl Memory wallet-owned: encrypted to a key only the owner can produce, written to Base, restored on any machine the owner connects, and checked against the chain before the agent acts on a recalled row. This page covers what kint does in v0.3.0, the pieces it is made of, what is live on Base mainnet, and how the rest of these docs are laid out.

Sibyl decides what the agent remembers. kint decides where that memory lives and who can read it: the wallet.
